4/10

The game shows promise as a terminal-command teaching tool, but the harsh difficulty curve and lack of guidance severely hamper its educational effectiveness. Players need more scaffolding to learn bash commands safely before facing consequences that end the session prematurely.
issues:
- Lost all HP in just 5 turns with basic exploration commands, suggesting overly punitive damage mechanics that discourage experimentation
- No clear indication of what caused HP loss or how to avoid it
- Limited command vocabulary (only 3 basic commands used) may indicate restricted gameplay or unclear available actions
- Timing out after only 10.4 seconds suggests either very aggressive time limits or insufficient feedback to guide player decisions
suggestions:
- Implement a health warning system before fatal damage occurs (e.g., "You feel weakened" before reaching 0 HP)
- Add `help` or `hint` commands to guide new players on available actions and safety mechanics
- Include more forgiving early game mechanics - perhaps a tutorial area where mistakes don't cause HP loss
- Provide clearer environmental descriptions that hint at dangers or safe exploration paths
- Consider adding an inventory tutorial early on, as empty inventory suggests missed learning opportunities
- Extend time limits or add pause functionality to allow thoughtful learning rather than rushed decisions
